rics.meaning: Total electricity sales across all sectors (residential, commercial, industrial, transportation).
rics.how_to_use: Real-economy demand gauge. Industrial sales lead manufacturing cycles; residential is weather-driven. Adjust for cooling/heating-degree-days for cycle signal.

rics.meaning: Cooling degree-days — sum of (daily mean temperature − 65°F) when above 65°F. Higher = more AC demand.
rics.how_to_use: Use to weather-adjust electricity, gas, and natgas storage data. Hot summer = high CDD = high electricity demand.

rics.meaning: Heating degree-days — sum of (65°F − daily mean) when below 65°F. Higher = more heating demand.
rics.how_to_use: Critical for natgas demand modeling — winter HDD drives storage drawdowns. Use 5-year normal as baseline.
Agricultural/hydro power input. Pair with crop progress reports for harvest forecasting.

rics.meaning: Total precipitation in millimeters — same data, metric units.
rics.how_to_use: Use whichever unit your model expects.

rics.meaning: Semiconductor equipment book-to-bill ratio — orders / shipments. Above 1.0 = orders outpace shipments (expanding).
rics.how_to_use: Leads semi capex cycle by 1-2 quarters. Watch for sustained sub-1.0 prints as recession warning.

rics.meaning: US proved crude oil reserves — annual.
rics.how_to_use: Reserve replacement ratio (additions vs production) is the long-run sustainability gauge. Surged with shale; growth slowing as best Permian acreage drilled.
US is now a net products exporter despite being a net crude importer until ~2019 — refinery capacity exceeds domestic demand.
Halved post-shale (2008-2020) but stable since. Source mix matters: Canada heavy crude is irreplaceable in Gulf Coast refineries.

rics.meaning: Gross natural gas withdrawals — total production from wells.
rics.how_to_use: US is world's largest natgas producer. Watch alongside Henry Hub prices and LNG export terminal utilization.

rics.description: STOCKS - CRUDE OIL EXCLUDING STRATEGIC PETROLEUM RESERVES
rics.meaning: Crude oil stocks excluding Strategic Petroleum Reserve.
rics.how_to_use: Most-watched oil inventory series. Weekly EIA report moves prices; surprises vs API/consensus drive intraday action.

rics.description: STOCKS - CRUDE OIL INCL STRATEGIC PETROLEUM RESERVES
rics.how_to_use: Less useful than ex-SPR — SPR moves are policy-driven, not market-driven.

rics.description: STOCKS - PETROLEUM & PRODUCTS INCL STRATEGIC PETROLEUM RESERVES
rics.meaning: Total petroleum and products stocks (crude + gasoline + distillates etc).
rics.how_to_use: Aggregate liquidity gauge. Big draws during driving season (gasoline) and winter (distillates).
Drained 200M+ bbl in 2022 (Russia/Ukraine response). Refilling has been slow. Below ~350M bbl is historically low.
